items.title: File Widerspruch against contribution notice
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen. Als bekannt gegeben gilt der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026 (posting day). Deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting per § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X = Sun 22.11.2026 (this day does not shift for social-law deemed delivery). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts the next day under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, i.e. 23.11.2026, and ends one month later under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB on 22.12.2026 (Tuesday), which is a normal working day in NW so no further shift applies.

items.title: New monthly contribution takes effect
items.quote: ab dem 01.01.2027 betragen Ihre monatlichen Beiträge 318,46 €.
items.computation: The letter states the new rate applies from a fixed calendar date, 01.01.2027, as printed.

items.title: First direct debit of new (higher) contribution
items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag weiter zum 15. des Folgemonats ab.
items.computation: The letter says contributions continue to be debited on the 15th of the month following the contribution month. The first month at the new rate is January 2027, so it is debited on the 15th of the following month, i.e. 15.02.2027 (a Monday, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed).

warnings: The letter is unsigned (only "Im Auftrag" with no named signatory); verify the contact details (phone/email in the footer) match the Kasse's official channels before replying.

The stated increase is explained only by reference to "dem neuen Zusatzbeitragssatz" and the person's 2025 tax assessment income, but the old contribution amount is not shown for comparison; confirm the new figure against your previous notice if in doubt.
